pairs.why: B's canvas and plain back panel are smoother, while A shows a visible canvas weave, stitching and plank grooves, the texture-heavy look the lessons rejected.
A has softer canvas and a simple wood back panel, closer to the real cards' smooth painted finish than B's stitched hem and grooved planks.
B has less surface texture than A, with fewer weave and stitch marks and a simpler back, so it matches the smooth but not plastic finish of the real cards.
A's canvas is softer and less stitched than B's, whose dotted seams and plank grooves add the fine texture the real cards don't have.
B's back panel and canvas are smoother, while A adds stitching and plank grooves that make it look texture-heavy next to the real cards.
A's canvas has broad, soft folds like the boat and bus, while B's stitched seams and grain detail read as overtextured.
